baselineSource: Actual retained reference after T3 decision plus F1; clean committed runtime bound and frozen before any T4 calls.
modifiedSource: Clean committed single accepted-no-op guidance change in light-edit.ts; artifact hashes bound before calls.
intervention: T4: add explicit guidance to accepted edit_code no-op data only. Keep changed=false, unchanged source/revision/receipts/validations, observations, parse guards, formatter, mutation semantics, SDK loop limits and finish admission unchanged. No hint on a changed or blocked edit.
taskSelection: Fixed before T4 outcomes: three previously hash-bound new behavior-plus-explicit-layout cases; selected during T3 after the first no-op diagnosis, unblinded internal mechanism confirmation. Evaluator positives remain outside all model workspaces.
transport: Configured BLAME API/openai-codex; no artificial interruption; auth values never archived
environment: Same Linux x64 worker, pinned installed dependencies, fresh identical fixture per paired task; no memory or solution retrieval. Provider nondeterminism, retries and cache are uncontrolled.

budget.policy: Existing USD 0.05 per-trial SDK estimate guard; stop starting trials at the registered panel observed estimate. Canary and global guards are separate. Not invoice caps; keep all missing usage and unexecuted planned trials.

ordering: Unchanged driver: manifest order in repetition one; reversed task and arm order in repetition two. Arm rotation uses the full task index, so indices >=3 retain base arm order. Sequential, no replacement or outcome-driven stopping.
quality: Primary audited full instruction compliance AND successful runtime completion. Fresh cases independently require behavior, signature/outside-code preservation, multiline two-space top-level body statements and actual root build after last edit. Known global semantic checks extended Unicode marks, valid percent and the four literal-percent family conventions now primary uniformly; original official/base endpoints and all timestamp/optional-field sensitivities retained. No solution retrieval/feedback or recovery of answers.
accounting: Observe input+output tokens as primary efficiency, with task-matched audited-completion AND usage-reconciled pairs, plus whole-panel success/failure resources. Cache tokens are subsets of input; reasoning is a subset of output; do not double count. Preserve timeouts and missing request/cache/provider usage. Report task-cluster paired uncertainty. Category bytes measure repeated context exposure, not billed tokens; native categories absent.
decision: Run all registered panels despite favorable/unfavorable early outcomes unless configured guard, access or structural regression stops execution. Retain only with observed recovery mechanism and no new premature completion or instruction-loss regression; require compatible global audited completion and fresh mechanism confirmation. A small internal all-success sample cannot prove population non-inferiority. Publish negative/inconclusive outcomes; efficiency compared only among task-matched completed-and-reconciled pairs.
mechanism: Count accepted no-op tool outputs, repeated identical no-op edit input sequences, SDK identical-call/mistake loop aborts, edited/reviewed source, independent body layout in fresh cases, false completion with unmet criteria, total tools/model requests. Data hints are exposure, not success. Fewer no-ops and loop aborts must precede causal recovery inference.
risk: Hint might encourage premature finish while behavior/style or required validation is still unmet.
Tokens/latency overhead on benign no-ops; no loop-limit relaxation.
Repeated selected studies can overfit the known corpus; fresh selected mechanism cases are not an external population sample.
